extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: belt conveyor, 3.2 m long, 0.58 m belt, working height 0.85 m
extras.notes: endless dark rubber belt around two pulleys, yellow side frames with bearing blocks, tube side guides, return idlers, two steel leg frames with braces and foot plates, dark gear motor at the drive end (front), yellow control box with red stop and mint start button, three plain cartons on the belt. Moving part: 'conveyor-belt_drum' (drive pulley + orange hub disc) with its origin on the pulley axis - spin around local Y; long axis = X, drive at +X; front = -Y; no text, no logo

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
